Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, where Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 1's
vehicle while both were traveling in the same lane. Driver 1 reported pain in the left shoulder and said the impact
jolted them forward against the seatbelt. A Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time and was present during
the collision. Driver 2 described the event the same way Driver 1 did, and two independent witnesses at the scene
gave statements consistent with that account. Photographs taken at the scene show rear-end damage to Driver 1's
vehicle. Several small scratches on the rear bumper appear weathered and may predate this crash, and officers
could not determine from the scene alone whether all of the visible damage resulted from this impact. Driver 1 is
listed as the named inusred on the policy shown in the exchanged insurance information. Driver 1 was transported for
evaluation and released later that day. No citations were issued at the scene.
